sentences.text: Author: Tirthankar Ghosh Bench: Tirthankar Ghosh  M/L 54 C.R.M. (M) 561 of 2025 01.12.2025 Bpg.

In Re: An application for Bail under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 as amended/ under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 filed in connection with Panskura Police Station Case No.494 of 2019 dated 04.10.2019 under Sections 366/376(D)/354(C)/506 of the Indian Penal Code;
Sk. Sonu @ Sk. Sahanuj @ Sk. Hasanuj Ali Versus The State of West Bengal & Anr.
Mr. Amal Krishna Samanta.
...for the petitioner.
Ms. Sonali Das Mr. Tirupati Mukherjee.
...for the State.
Learned advocate appearing for the petitioner submits that the trial has been concluded, as such,
the bail application has become infructuous.

entities.text: Sonu @ Sk. Sahanuj @ Sk. Hasanuj Ali
entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text: Learned advocate for the State is present.
In view of the submissions advanced by the learned advocate appearing for the petitioner, the application for bail being CRM(M) 561 of 2025 is dismissed as not pressed.
All parties shall act on the server copy of this order duly downloaded from the official website of this Court.
Urgent photostat certified copy of this order, if applied for, be supplied to the parties upon compliance of all requisite formalities.

(Tirthankar Ghosh, J.)
